test_cases.summary:
Verify Color updates after status change
when a session changes from "In Progress" to "Yet to do"

Feature: Yet To Do Status Color Indicator
Scenario: Color updates after status change
Given a session changes from “In Progress” to “Yet to do”
When the page refreshes or updates
Then the badge should immediately turn red
test_cases.acceptance:
The badge should immediately turn red
The behavior should be validated when the page refreshes or updates.
